claim_1.assertion: Every original security cohort receives at least as much cash in the USD 241 million offer as in the USD 240 million offer.

claim_2.assertion: The Series A-1 cohort receives no cash at the USD 240 million offer but receives positive cash at the USD 2,500 million offer.

claim_3.assertion: The total contractual cash settlement owed to all unissued equity award holders in an actual liquidation would be zero.
